If you’re looking to create a reclaimed barnwood accent wall, wainscot or any other type of wood feature, GenStone faux wood wall panels are faster and easier to install and offer the same look of real reclaimed wood without the added cost of sourcing hard to find barnwood. Not to mention, GenStone wood wall panels are cast from real reclaimed barnwood to ensure the exact same texture found in real wood planks and hand stained by artisans to recreated the distinct colors seen throughout reclaimed barnwood planks.

GenStone faux wood wall panels come in 5 unique colors that can be installed in any combination to create your unique reclaimed barnwood wall. We have curated some example wood wall panel combinations here and as always, if you need help with color selection or how many wood wall panels you need for your project, just tap Project SOS to be connected to a Project Coordinator at GenStone.
